modmenu.descriptionTranslation.qol_unifi: An all-in-one, modular, client-side quality-of-life mod.
qol_unified.settings.title: QoL: Unified Settings
qol_unified.settings.empty: No features are available yet. Features will appear here as they are added in future versions.
qol_unified.settings.restart_required_su: Takes effect after restarting the game
qol_unified.tooltip.unknown: Could not be fully disabled and may still be active. Retry, or restart the game to be sure.
qol_unified.message.read_only: Settings cannot be saved: the configuration file is from a newer version or could not be safely read.
qol_unified.message.invalid: Fix the highlighted values before saving.
qol_unified.message.save_failed: Settings could not be saved. Your changes were kept here; see the log.
qol_unified.message.apply_failed: Settings were saved, but some features could not be changed: %s. See the log.
qol_unified.message.restart: Settings saved. Some changes take effect after restarting the game.
qol_unified.message.retry_failed: The feature still could not be disabled. Restart the game to be sure.
qol_unified.error.not_a_number: Enter a whole number between %s and %s.
qol_unified.feature.food_hud.name: Food HUD
qol_unified.feature.food_hud.description: Shows your saturation and what held food would restore. Previews are estimates.
qol_unified.feature.food_hud.conflict.ap: AppleSkin shows the same food information on the HUD and in tooltips.
qol_unified.food_hud.debug: Food: %s, saturation: %s (last value sent by the server)
qol_unified.feature.chat_heads.name: Chat Heads
qol_unified.feature.chat_heads.descripti: Shows the sender's head next to player chat messages. Only messages that carry the sender's profile get a head.
Chat Heads adds heads to the same chat messages.
